API Reference¶

Public Modules¶

These are the modules most users need when building models, choosing regularizers, setting solver options, and inspecting results.

CompositeOT.model

Problem representation for the CompositeOT solver.

CompositeOT.regularizers

Regularizers and proximal modules for CompositeOT.

CompositeOT.options

Validated solver option containers for CompositeOT.

CompositeOT.results

Reusable solution, result, and history containers for CompositeOT.

CompositeOT.solver

Public CompositeOT solve entry point.
